data: In the tree on the right, what is the shape of the bottom-most node?

The question asks about the shape of the bottom-most node in the tree on the right. The bottom-most node in the tree appears to be a circle, which represents a modifier according to the caption. Therefore, the shape of the bottom-most node is circular.
